```{r Write problems intro}
#| output: asis

# A report with nothing to report says so and stops here: the introduction,
# the problem details and the solutions all cross-reference sections that
# exist only when there are findings to explain.
if (nrow(problems) == 0L) {
  cat(sR$no_problems_detected, "\n")
} else {
  cat(
    sep = "\n",
    knitr::knit_child(text = readr::read_file(Sys.glob(paste0(language, "/_problems_intro.Rmd"))), quiet = TRUE),
    ""
  )
}
```

{{< include _problems.qmd >}}

```{r Write problem details}
#| output: asis

if (nrow(problems) > 0L) {

cat("::: {.content-visible unless-format=\"html\"}", "\\newpage", ":::", "", sep = "\n")

# Problem details intro
cat(
  sep = "\n",
  knitr::knit_child(text = readr::read_file(Sys.glob(paste0(language, "/_problem_details_intro.Rmd"))), quiet = TRUE),
  ""
)

# Problem details
sortedDetails <- problem_detail_info |>
  dplyr::semi_join(
    problem_info |>
      dplyr::filter(id %in% report_problems) |>
      dplyr::select(usedDetails) |>
      tidyr::unnest_longer(usedDetails),
    dplyr::join_by(id == usedDetails)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(sortOrder) |>
  dplyr::mutate(filePath = paste0(language, "/_problem_detail_", sprintf("%04d", id), ".Rmd")) |>
  dplyr::select(filePath, usedSolutions) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

# po4a omits a localized problem-detail file whenever its translation falls
# below the completeness threshold, and the absence is reported by the file
# simply not being there — so resolving these by glob dropped the problem's
# explanation from the report with no error and no trace. Fall back to the
# English source, which is always present, so an untranslated detail degrades
# to English rather than to silence.
localized_details <- sortedDetails$filePath
english_details <- sub("^[^/]+/", "en/", localized_details)
untranslated <- !file.exists(localized_details)

if (any(untranslated))
  logWarn("Problem detail(s) not available in this language, using English: ",
          paste(basename(localized_details[untranslated]), collapse = ", "))

problem_detail_files <- ifelse(untranslated, english_details, localized_details)
absent <- !file.exists(problem_detail_files)

if (any(absent))
  logError("Problem detail(s) missing in every language: ",
           paste(basename(problem_detail_files[absent]), collapse = ", "))

problem_detail_files <- problem_detail_files[!absent]

# Every child is followed by a blank line of its own. A file that ends without
# a final newline would otherwise run straight into the next file's first line,
# and Pandoc reads a heading or a fence on the line after a paragraph as part
# of that paragraph — so a `:::` opening the next file became literal text.
for (problem_detail_file in problem_detail_files) {
  cat(sep = "\n", knitr::knit_child(quiet = TRUE, text = readr::read_file(problem_detail_file)), "")
}

cat("::: {.content-visible unless-format=\"html\"}", "\\newpage", ":::", "", sep = "\n")

# Solutions intro
cat(
  sep = "\n",
  knitr::knit_child(text = readr::read_file(Sys.glob(paste0(language, "/_solutions_intro.Rmd"))), quiet = TRUE),
  ""
)

# Solutions
solution_files <- solution_info |>
  dplyr::semi_join(
    sortedDetails |>
      dplyr::select(usedSolutions) |>
      tidyr::unnest_longer(usedSolutions),
    dplyr::join_by(id == usedSolutions)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(sortOrder) |>
  dplyr::mutate(filePath = paste0(language, "/_solution_", sprintf("%04d", id), ".Rmd"), .keep = "none") |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::pull(filePath) |>
  Sys.glob()

for (solution_file in solution_files) {
  cat(sep = "\n", knitr::knit_child(quiet = TRUE, text = readr::read_file(solution_file)), "")
}

}
```
